verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a contract-management SaaS like Ironclad, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency for data held in Ironclad. The closest items are API data exports and an API option to persist signed agreements to an internal system. Those copy data out of Ironclad; they do not control where Ironclad itself stores it, so they are not region selection.
